msg: Hello! I'm American but I have lived in Medellín for three years and I have a cédula de extranjería. My friend is visiting from Texas and has no Colombian documents. We are both certified and want to do the three-dive day from Cartagena. Which price do we each pay and how do we book?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

The online discount is applied automatically when booking through our website.

The three-dive day includes two daytime dives and one night dive. You’ll need to stay overnight on the islands; lodging isn’t included. The boat trip from Cartagena and lunch are included.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• 3-dive package (1 day, 2 daytime + 1 night dive): 287 USD · 319 USD
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 178 USD · 197 USD
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 316 USD · 351 USD

This package doesn’t have an online booking link, so a team advisor needs to arrange the booking.

Since the group mixes Colombians or residents with international guests, the whole booking is paid in US dollars (USD) at the same price: only the currency changes.

Would you like me to connect you with one?

msg: Thanks, but which price do I pay with my cédula? And is there really no online link for the three-dive day? We don't mind staying over, we will find our own hotel.
reply:
With your cédula de extranjería, you pay in COP. The price is the same; only the currency changes. Your friend pays in USD, and because the booking includes an international guest, the whole booking is paid in USD.

There’s no online booking link for the three-dive package. A team advisor arranges it in the chat. Your own hotel is fine—the package requires an overnight stay on the islands, and accommodation isn’t included. The boat trip from Cartagena and lunch are included.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• 3-dive package (1 day, 2 daytime + 1 night dive): 287 USD · 319 USD
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 178 USD · 197 USD
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 316 USD · 351 USD

Groups of 5 or more get a 10% group discount, on top of the 10% online discount, on recreational diving, the mini-course and snorkeling (not on PADI courses); it is not applied automatically: it has to be requested from the team before paying.

Just to confirm, should I change it?
• not Colombian → *Colombian or resident*
